description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for managing Kubernetes Pod resources, including create, update, delete, get, list, watch, patch, apply, and specialized update methods for ephemeral containers and resize operations.

classes.name: pods
classes.description: Implementation of the PodInterface for managing Pod resources within a specific namespace.

methods.name: newPods
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new 'pods' client for a given namespace.

methods.name: UpdateEphemeralContainers
methods.description: Updates ephemeral containers in a specified Pod.

methods.name: UpdateResize
methods.description: Updates the resize subresource of a specified Pod.
